title: Chirpy
tagline: Discover Chirpy, your AI buddy that keeps you updated on the latest community events. Forget about info overload and FOMO – Chirpy has you covered!
description: Chirpy is an innovative AI companion designed to address the challenges of information overload and FOMO (Fear of Missing Out) in the fast-paced world of crypto and community-building. This project aims to streamline community building by empowering users, especially community builders and Web3 enthusiasts, to effortlessly organize events, share relevant information, and foster engagement within vibrant and connected spaces. Chirpy integrates with Lens Protocol, offering features like a voting system for collective decision-making within communities, the ability for users to mint NFTs directly on Telegram, and the convenience of posting text and photos within the platform. The goal is to enhance user experience, encourage efficient communication, and provide a comprehensive solution for staying active and informed in the dynamic landscape of web3.
how_its_made: In constructing our Telegram bot with Lens' client, the project is meticulously developed using Python-telegram-bot, Lens API, Lens SDK, WalletConnect, Worldcoin ID, Auto-nounify.wtf, and Solidity for smart contracts. The user journey involves initial verification through Worldcoin ID or Next ID to confirm their identity as a human. Subsequently, users connect and sign in using Lens SDK, acquiring a JWT token. For an enhanced social media experience, we leverage Lens' API for feed retrieval and publication posting. Additionally, our team member's Auto-nounify project is integrated to introduce a photo filter, elevating the user experience with a touch of enjoyment.
